_comment: EXAMPLE FILE. Copy to company_context.json and replace with your own company's details, or run /intel-setup and let the plugin draft this file for you from your website. This file is injected into every agent run, so it shapes every brief, battlecard, and recommendation. The values below describe a fictional company (Northwind Analytics) purely to show the shape.
tagline: Product analytics for teams that ship fast
key_differentiators: Warehouse-native: runs on the customer's own data warehouse, no data duplication
Self-serve setup in under an hour, no implementation services required
Transparent usage-based pricing with a generous free tier
Deep product-led-growth workflows out of the box
known_weaknesses: Smaller template and integration library than the incumbent
Less brand recognition with enterprise buyers

Competitor A: A large partner and integration marketplace
Competitor B: New AI 'ask your data' natural-language query assistant
Session replay bundled into the core plan

win_themes: Warehouse-native means no data leaves the customer's control
Time-to-value in hours, not a six-week implementation
Pricing that scales with value, not seats
loss_themes: Competitor A wins on enterprise governance and procurement comfort
Competitor B wins on breadth of features in a single bundle

icp.primary: Product and growth teams at 50-1,000 person B2B SaaS companies with a modern data warehouse
icp.buyer: Head of Product, Head of Growth, or a product-led-growth lead
buyer_personas: Economic buyer: VP Product or VP Growth who owns the activation and retention number
Champion and daily user: a product analyst or PLG lead who lives in the tool

regulatory_focus._comment: What regulation, compliance, or standards actually move demand in YOUR category. The regulatory-radar agent keys off this. A safety or contractor-management product would list OSHA, EPA, ISO 45001; a fintech product would list SEC, PCI, state money-transmission rules. This analytics example lists data-privacy and AI-governance rules.
domains: EU AI Act as it touches product analytics
regulatory_focus.why_it_matters: Buyers increasingly require that product data never leave their warehouse or region. New privacy and AI-governance rules strengthen the warehouse-native pitch.

community_sources._comment: Where your buyers actually talk unfiltered. The news-scanner community pass keys off this instead of guessing. List subreddits, Slack and Discord communities, and forums relevant to YOUR market.
